verdict.rationale: The evidence shows IRS publishing form-related guidance on public irs.gov content pages, such as the Pub 525 update on the 83(b) election naming Form 15620. It also documents a paper rail for Form SS-4 by mail or fax, which implies the form itself is obtainable outside the account-gated flows. The online signed-form path does require an Online Account (OLA), but no item explicitly documents account-free PDF downloads of forms and their instructions. missing for 10: explicit documentation that form PDFs and instructions are downloadable without an account, a forms/instructions download page in evidence, hands-on confirmation of an account-free download
